headline: 16-Year-Old Lifeguard Performs Heroic Ocean Rescue in California
meta_description: A 16-year-old high school lifeguard named Ryder performed one of the most heroic rescues witnessed in California, saving a 10-year-old boy from powerful waves.
summary_short: A 16-year-old lifeguard named Ryder pulled off a heroic rescue when a 10-year-old boy was swept away by powerful waves off the California coast.
body:
A 16-year-old high school lifeguard saved a 10-year-old boy who was being swept away by powerful waves in California. Witnesses described the rescue as one of the most heroic they had ever seen.

The lifeguard, identified as Ryder, was praised for his quick action and bravery. The teenager's mother confirmed his identity on social media following the incident, which was captured on video. The footage circulated widely on social media, with people marveling at how a high school student managed to execute such a dangerous water rescue under extreme conditions.

The incident highlights the vital role young lifeguards play in protecting beachgoers, and how training and composure can make the difference between tragedy and survival.
quick_facts: Rescued a 10-year-old boy from powerful waves
Rescue captured on video and witnessed by onlookers
